neighbours.label: the token ' &' joining two operands or names (pandas boolean masks, 'Simon & Schuster'), plus bracketed citation numbers
fire: The novel was first published by Simon & Schuster in 1987.
Smith, J. & Jones, K. (2004). Learning to read. London: Hodder & Stoughton.
Resistance to these drugs is rising worldwide (1, 2).
Several trials have reported similar effects [14, 15].
The firm was founded as Johnson & Sons in a small shop in Leeds.
quiet: The novel was first published by a small press in 1987.
Smith and Jones wrote a book about learning to read in London.
Resistance to these drugs is rising worldwide, doctors say.
Several trials have reported similar effects in older patients.
The firm was founded by Johnson and his sons in a small shop in Leeds.

notes: Card: ' &' x8 (pandas masks, publisher names), digits x11 (citation numbers '(1,2)', '[14, 15]'). The shared pattern may be 'a short connective/number inside a reference or expression'; test leans on ' &'. Near misses use 'and' / no citation.
